'''John M. McNamara''' is an English mathematical biologist and Emeritus Professor of Mathematics and Biology in the School of Mathematics at the [[University of Bristol]]. He was elected a fellow of the [[Royal Society]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite web |title=John McNamara |url=https://royalsociety.org/people/john-mcnamara-11939/ |website=Royal Society |accessdate=20 January 2019 |language=en-gb}}</ref> In 2013, he and [[Alasdair Houston]] jointly received the [[ASAB Medal]], and in 2014, he received the [[Weldon Memorial Prize]]. In 2018, he was awarded the [[Sewall Wright Award]] from the [[American Society of Naturalists]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Professor John McNamara awarded Sewall Wright Award |url=https://www.bristol.ac.uk/maths/news/2018/john-mcnamara-award-april-2018.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190120093851/https://www.bristol.ac.uk/maths/news/2018/john-mcnamara-award-april-2018.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=20 January 2019 |website=University of Bristol |accessdate=20 January 2019 |date=11 April 2018 }}</ref>
